pageDescription: Register remote Kandev instances and monitor their health from this panel.
groupDescription: Each enabled instance is proxied locally and health-checked every 90 seconds.
name: Name
baseUrlDescription: The remote instance's API origin, including its port.
baseUrlHelp: Point this at the remote backend's HTTP address, for example {{example}}. Use the address you open the remote Kandev UI at.
credentialSecretIdDescription: Optional. A secret holding the remote API token.
credentialSecretIdHelp: Create the token on the remote instance and store it in Secrets, then reference its ID here. Leave empty when the remote instance runs without authentication.
enabledDescription: Disabled instances keep their registration but stop proxying and event relaying.
healthWaiting: Waiting for the first health check...
noInstances: No remote instances registered yet. Add one to manage it from this panel.
nameAndBaseUrlRequired: A name and a base URL are required
